finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹800 Cr, EBITDA margin = 15%, Debt = ₹300 Cr, Interest rate = 10%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹120 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹30 Cr = ₹90 Cr.
New revenue = ₹720 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹108 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹78 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-12 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
